text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back to the academy with 
Manhattan Cafe――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following the gaze of her sudden stop, 
there stood a gardening supplies shop.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer-san... Would it be all right 
if we stopped by that shop?
choice_data_list: Sure, no problem.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Did she have an interest in gardening? 
Curious, the two of us stepped into the 
shop.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the store, Manhattan Cafe compared 
various fertilizers, purchased a few of 
them, and stepped outside.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Thank goodness. They had the fertilizer 
I was looking for...
choice_data_list: So what are you growing?
What are you growing?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's a... coffee plant... I'm... growing 
it in the dorm...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
From coffee plants... you can harvest 
coffee cherries, and—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The seeds inside those coffee cherries... 
are what become coffee beans...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I see, it's a plant very typical of 
someone who loves coffee. Perhaps it's 
just my imagination, but her voice sounds 
somewhat cheerful as she explains it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
For a single coffee tree to grow enough... 
to yield a harvest... It takes at least... 
three whole years.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it can only be harvested... once 
a year...
choice_data_list: This is incredibly valuable, huh.
This is incredibly valuable, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why... a cup brewed from 
those beans is――――

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It becomes... something special... and 
irreplaceable...
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to getting to drink 
it.
I can't wait to get to drink it!
Making everything yourself is amazing.
Making everything yourself is amazing.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It becomes... something special... and 
irreplaceable...
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to getting to drink 
it.
I can't wait to get to drink it!
Making everything yourself is amazing.
Making everything yourself is amazing.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, it's home-grown by an 
amateur... so if you ask whether it's 
tastier than store-bought beans... it's 
hard to say..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
“Still... there is a flavor here... that 
cannot be measured... by simple 
'deliciousness' alone...”
choice_data_list:
That's a privilege only for the person who 
raised them.

That's a privilege only for the person who 
raised them, huh.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...What if... when... came to...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe murmured something, but it 
was so quiet I couldn't hear it.
choice_data_list: Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ......No. It's... nothing......

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
There are more and more... voices around 
us... ............Let's head back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was curious about what she started to 
say, but feeling it would be wrong to 
press the issue, I headed back to the 
academy for the day.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That's not true...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Some didn't survive the winter... some 
got scorched leaves... some had bugs I 
missed..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I've failed at raising them... so many 
times...
choice_data_list:
But you've kept raising it all this time, 
huh.

But you've kept raising it all this time, 
haven't you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
When we get to harvest after all that hard 
work... it makes me so very happy...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Because I'll be able to find... a coffee 
made just for me...
choice_data_list:
I hope we have a safe harvest again this 
time.

I hope we get a good harvest again this 
time.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...What if... when... came to...

text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe murmured something, but it

press the issue, I headed back to the
